mapper.sql: c.id AS id, c.post_id AS postId, c.author AS author, c.author_type AS authorType, c.date_gmt AS dateGmt, c.user_id AS userId, c.content AS content, c.vote_positive AS votePositive, c.vote_negative AS voteNegative, c.sub_comment_count AS subCommentCount, c.images AS images, c.ip_location AS ipLocation, c.avatar_ref AS avatarRef, c.avatar_type AS avatarType, c.author_membership AS authorMembership, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM `${schema}`.comments c WHERE c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY c.date_gmt DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `${schema}`.comments c WHERE c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

SELECT c.author AS author, COALESCE(SUM(c.vote_positive), 0) AS totalLikes, COALESCE(SUM(c.vote_negative), 0) AS totalDislikes, COALESCE(SUM(c.sub_comment_count), 0) AS commentsReceived, COUNT(*) AS articlesPosted FROM `${schema}`.comments c GROUP BY c.author HAVING totalLikes > 1000 OR totalDislikes > 1000 OR commentsReceived > 1000 ORDER BY totalLikes DESC, articlesPosted DESC

SELECT a.title AS title, a.article_url AS articleUrl, a.article_id AS articleId, a.area AS area, a.is_new_user_post AS isNewUserPost, a.author AS author, a.publish_time AS publishTime, a.reply_count AS replyCount, a.read_count AS readCount, a.last_replier AS lastReplier, a.last_reply_time AS lastReplyTime FROM `${schema}`.aish2 a ORDER BY a.last_reply_time DESC, a.article_id DESC
